# A first-level heading

A paragraph with **bold**, *italic*, ~~struck~~, `code`, a [link](https://example.com),
a [[Wikilink]], an [[Other note|alias]], a #tag, <u>underlined</u>, x<sup>2</sup> and
H<sub>2</sub>O. A sentence long enough to wrap at the width the golden is drawn at,
so that the wrapping itself is part of what is pinned, and a footnote[^1].

## Maths

Inline, in a sentence: the set $[a] = \{x \in \mathcal{A} \mid x \sim a\}$ and the
vector $\overrightarrow{PQ} = \mathbf{v}$ sit on the line with the words around them.

$$
\int_0^1 x^2 \, dx = \frac{1}{3}
$$
